detail.text: WARNING: SERIOUS INFUSION-RELATED REACTIONS and NEUROTOXICITY — DANYELZA can cause serious infusion reactions (including cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, hypotension, bronchospasm, stridor) and severe neurotoxicity (including severe neuropathic pain, transverse myelitis, and RPLS).

citations.quote: ## WARNING: SERIOUS INFUSION-RELATED REACTIONS and NEUROTOXICITY
DANYELZA can cause serious infusion reactions, including cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, hypotension, bronchospasm, and stridor. Infusion reactions of any Grade occurred in 94-100% of patients.
DANYELZA can cause severe neurotoxicity, including severe neuropathic pain, transverse myelitis and reversible posterior leukoencephalopathy syndrome (RPLS).
